description: HISTORICAL DOCUMENTATION ONLY - this file is NOT loaded by any code. Live blend weights come from the _RANKING_SOURCES registry in src/api/data_contract.py (all 1.0 by policy, enforced by tests/api/test_source_registry_parity.py). Kept for the historical weight_rationale notes below. (2026-07-25 calculation audit, finding F-9.)

weight_rationale.KTC: Primary crowdsourced offense market source with the largest player pool.
weight_rationale.IDPTRADECALC: Primary IDP value source covering both offense and IDP players. Backbone for IDP ladder translation.
weight_rationale.DLF_IDP: DLF Dynasty League Football full-board IDP expert consensus (185 players, DL/LB/DB together). Rank-based signal, blended via coverage-aware mean.
weight_rationale.FANTASYPROS_SF: FantasyPros Dynasty Superflex offense expert consensus. Rank-based signal (~250 QB/RB/WR/TE players).
weight_rationale.DYNASTY_DADDY_SF: Dynasty Daddy Superflex crowd-sourced trade values via JSON API. Value-based signal (~320 QB/RB/WR/TE players). Standard SF — no TE premium.
weight_rationale.FANTASYCALC: FantasyCalc Dynasty SF crowd-sourced trade values via public JSON API (api.fantasycalc.com). Value-based signal (~450 QB/RB/WR/TE players). Standard SF (numQbs=2) — the crowd does NOT natively price in TE premium, so the global tepMultiplier applies on top of this source's contribution.
weight_rationale.OTCFFB_SF: OTC Fantasy Football Superflex trade-derived values via public JSON API (otcffb.com/api/trade-values?format=sf). Value-based signal (~470 QB/RB/WR/TE players) on a 0-100 scale derived from ~350k tracked community trades. Standard SF — no TE premium.
weight_rationale.FLOCK_FANTASY_SF: Flock Fantasy Superflex expert consensus averaged ranks via JSON API. Rank-based signal (~370 QB/RB/WR/TE players). Standard SF — no TE premium.
weight_rationale.YAHOO_BOONE: Justin Boone's monthly Yahoo dynasty trade value charts (QB/RB/WR/TE). Rank-based signal combining the 2QB QB column with the TE-premium TE column — natively sized to our Superflex + TEP league. ~500 players.

how_to_tune: DO NOT EDIT EXPECTING EFFECT - editing this file changes nothing. To adjust a source weight, change its registry entry in src/api/data_contract.py::_RANKING_SOURCES (and mirror in frontend/lib/dynasty-data.js), or use per-user overrides via POST /api/rankings/overrides.
